name: EnableHBaseueModule

parameters.help_en: The name of the extension cluster
parameters.name: module_cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the VPC
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络下的虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the master node. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html operation to obtain the specification value
parameters.help_zh: Master节点规格，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html接口获取规格值
parameters.name: master_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the core node. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html operation to obtain the specification value
parameters.help_zh: Core节点规格，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html接口获取规格值
parameters.name: core_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk type of the core node. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
local_hdd_pro: local HDD.
local_ssd_pro: local SSD.
cloud_essd_pl1: ESSD
parameters.help_zh:
Core磁盘类型，取值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
local_hdd_pro：本地HDD盘。
local_ssd_pro：本地SSD盘。
cloud_essd_pl1：ESSD云盘
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk size per node. Unit: GB.

If the instance is a single-node instance, the disk size of a single core node ranges from 20 to 500 GB, with a step size of 1 GB.
If the instance uses cloud disks, the disk size of a single core node ranges from 400 to 64,000 GB, with a step size of 40 GB
parameters.help_zh:
每个节点磁盘大小，单位：GB。

如果实例为单节点，Core单节点磁盘容量的范围为20~500 GB，步长为1 GB。
如果实例为云盘版，Core单节点磁盘容量的范围为400~64000 GB，步长为40 GB
parameters.name: disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes. Valid values:

If the instance is a single-node instance, the number of core nodes is fixed to 1.
If the instance uses cloud disks, the number of core nodes ranges from 2 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
节点个数，取值如下：

如果实例为单节点，Core节点个数固定为1个。
如果实例为云盘版，Core节点个数取值范围为2~100
parameters.name: node_count

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：

Prepaid：包年包月（预付费）。
Postpaid：按量付费（后付费）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration for the subscription instance. Valid values:

year
month

This parameter is required only when the billing method is Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月实例的购买单位，取值：

year：年。
month：月。

仅当实例的付费类型为Prepaid时，需要填写此参数
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the subscription instance. Valid values:

If PeriodUnit is set to year, the valid values are 1 to 3.
If PeriodUnit is set to month, the valid values are 1 to 9.

This parameter is required only when the billing method is Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月实例的购买时长，取值：

当PeriodUnit为year时，取值范围为1~3。
当PeriodUnit为month时，取值范围为1~9。

仅当实例的付费类型为Prepaid时，需要填写此参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period of the instance. Unit: months.
  • The default value of the auto-renewal period is 0, which indicates that the instance is not automatically renewed after the instance expires.
  • For example, if the auto-renewal period is set to 2, the instance is automatically renewed for two months after the instance expires.
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例自动续费周期，单位为月。
  • 自动续费周期默认值为0，表示实例到期后不自动续费。
  • 例如自动续费周期设置为2，表示实例到期后自动续费2个月。
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is generated by the client. The value must be unique among different requests, is case-sensitive, and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition database
parameters.name: hbaseue_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BDS cluster associated with the ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition instance
parameters.help_zh: HBase增强版实例中关联的BDS集群ID
parameters.name: bds_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the extension module. Set the value to solr
parameters.help_zh: 扩展模块类型，固定取值为solr
parameters.name: module_type_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the instance resides. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to obtain the zone ID
parameters.name: zone_id
